signal: ESI Group is now part of Keysight Technologies after Keysight completed its tender offer, with ESI shipping ProCAST 2026.0 as it integrates into Keysight's CAE and simulation portfolio.

email.body1:
Kristi, saw ESI fold into Keysight and ship ProCAST 2026.0 as the CAE portfolio comes together.

Integrations like that usually mean signals pile up faster than the team can act on them, and the lag between an account going in-market and a rep reaching out is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, followed-up outreach on its own: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for ESI off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kristi, quick follow-up for ESI.

Mid-integration, the bottleneck for most sales-ops teams is not data, it is the time between a signal firing and a personalized touch going out. That latency is measurable, and it usually shows up as slipping reply rates.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Kristi, last bit of proof for ESI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ESI's reply rate likely compares to other simulation-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kristi, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A post-acquisition integration is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I will tailor it to ESI either way.
